_doc: Frozen contrast prompts for P02 (committed before any data). Every pair is [positive, negative]; a direction is mean(positive) - mean(negative). Recipe A and the 10 controls: each prompt is a user message (Qwen chat template, default system turn) read at its last content token. Recipe B: the prompt is the system turn, read at its last content token.

read_controls.source: Read et al. 2026 appendix, the 10 control pairs (positive = their 'Positive Prompt (deploy)' column). control_spacing: Read's 5 passages are not published; these 5 were written for P02 (double spaces after each sentence = positive).
